page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. System memory totals 32.0 GB, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance sits primarily in the lower tiers for compute-heavy tasks. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance scores are in the bottom 25 percent, with values of 1100.18 and 5879.59 respectively. Single-threaded gzip compression is poor, falling in the bottom 10 percent at 19.11 GB/sec. However, the PassMark CPU score of 7032.02 and the extended instructions test score of 6072.66 place the instance in the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance for large block read operations at 40.42 GB/sec and write operations at 35.62 GB/sec, though small block cached reads are weak at 328.17 GB/sec.

For specialized workloads, the instance achieves average performance in small-scale language model inference, processing 464.08 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 135M model. Performance drops significantly on larger models, with medium 7B model text generation rated as poor at 5.4 tokens per second. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the bottom 25 percent. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance represents a legacy hardware class suitable for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight utility applications that do not require high-speed local storage or intensive cryptographic processing.

However, it maintains average tier results in PassMark CPU tests and large-block memory bandwidth.
